message.content:
Based on a critical comparison of the **OLD (Sept 17)** and **NEW (today)** screenshots, here is the detailed analysis:

### (1) Order of Elements Left-to-Right
The order of elements is **completely different** between the two images because they show opposite ends of the parking map.

*   **Image 1 (OLD - Right Side/End):** The sequence from left-to-right is:  
    `[-14]` (partial slot) → **Wall** → `[A-15]`, `[A-16]`, `[A-17]`, `[A-18]` (Slots) → **[ENTER / MASUK]** block → *(End of row)*.  
    Second row: `(partial)` → **Wall** → `[B-13]`, `[B-14]` (Slots) → **[EXIT / KELUAR]** block → **[RAMP/LIFT]** block (vertical blue rectangle with chevron) → *(End of row)*.

*   **Image 2 (NEW - Left Side/Start):** The sequence from left-to-right is:  
    **[A-01], [A-02], [A-03]** (Slots) → **[A-04], [A-05], [A-06]** (Slots) → *(End of row)*.  
    Second row: **[B-01], [B-02], [B-03]** (Slots) → **[B-04], [B-05], [B-06]** (Slots) → *(End of row)*.

**Critical Note:** The NEW image shows the **beginning** of the map (slots A-01 to B-06), while the OLD image shows the **end** (slots A-15/B-13 onwards plus the entrance/exit/ramp infrastructure). You cannot see the Entrance, Exit, or Ramp in the new screenshot because it is scrolled to the far left.

### (2) Is the RAMP Block Different?
**The RAMP block is not visible in the NEW image.**  
In the OLD image, the RAMP (or Lift) is clearly visible as a tall, narrow vertical blue block with a white downward chevron (↓) and vertical text "LIFT/RAMP" located at the far right of the second row (after the EXIT block). The NEW image cuts off after slot B-06, so no comparison of size, shape, or styling is possible from these specific screenshots.

### (3) Misalignment or Visual Defects in the NEW one vs OLD?
Yes, there are notable visual differences and potential defects in the NEW version:

*   **Language & Localization:** The UI has changed from **English** ("Parking Map", "Free", "Booked") to **Indonesian** ("Peta Parkir", "Kosong", "Terbooking"). This suggests a localization update.
*   **Header Information:** The NEW header includes an **"OFFLINE" status indicator** and attributes the building to "**BINUS @ Kemanggisan**" (which may be a data error if this is supposed to be the Anggrek campus, or indicates a different branch). The old header was cleaner.
*   **Instruction Text:** The instructional text below the slots changed from *"Cars enter top-right..."* to *"Mobil masuk lewat kanan-atas..."*.
*   **Button Text:** The bottom swipe button changed from *"Swipe to see all slots"* to *"Geser untuk melihat semua slot"*.
*   **Visual Defect/Misalignment:** In the NEW image, slot **A-03** is highlighted in **red** (indicating "Occupied/Terisi"), whereas the old image showed all visible slots as green ("Free"). While this is a status change, not necessarily a rendering defect, the red styling appears slightly more opaque/solid compared to the translucent green of other slots.
*   **Missing Elements:** The NEW image lacks the **Entrance (ENTER)**, **Exit (EXIT)**, **Ramp**, **Wall**, and **partial slot [-14]** seen in the old image, but this is due to scroll position, not a defect.

### (4) Overall: Did the Layout CHANGE?
**Yes, the layout and content have changed significantly:**

1.  **Scroll Position:** The most obvious change is that you are looking at the **left side (start)** of the parking grid in the new image, versus the **right side (end)** in the old image. The physical arrangement of slots A-01 through B-06 was not visible before.
2.  **UI Overhaul:** The interface underwent a **localization update** (English → Indonesian) and branding update (adding "BINUS" and offline status).
3.  **Data State Change:** The parking availability state has updated. Specifically, slot **A-03 is now shown as Occupied (Red)** in the new image, whereas all visible slots in the old image were Free (Green).
4.  **Structural Layout (Inference):** If we assume the map is a continuous horizontal scroll, the **overall layout** now confirms the full sequence starts at A-01 (left) and ends at A-18/Exit/Ramp (right). The "Entrance" is at the right end (top-right as per the instruction text), meaning cars enter at the end of the row (near A-18) and park moving leftward toward A-01.

**Conclusion:** The application was updated with Indonesian language support and you are currently viewing the opposite end of the parking map compared to the September 17th screenshot. The Ramp/Exit infrastructure remains at the far right (as seen in the old image) and is not visible in the current view.
